items.name: Flashback
items.oracle_text: Target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost. (You may cast that card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
items.flavor_text: Quintorius found that every new discovery motivated him to keep exploring.
items.atomic_translated_text: 目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得返照异能直到回合结束。其返照费用等同于其法术力费用。（你可以从你坟墓场施放该牌，并支付其返照费用，然后将它放逐。）
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 昆托力意识到，每有一个新发现，都会让自己更想再去探索。

items.name: Flash Photography
items.atomic_translated_text: 如果此咒语以由你操控的永久物为目标，则你可以将它视同具有闪现异能地来施放。\n派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标永久物之复制品。\n返照{4}{U}{U}

items.name: Flash Thompson, Spider-Fan
items.oracle_text:
Flash
When Flash Thompson enters, choose one or both —
• Heckle — Tap target creature.
• Hero Worship — Untap target creature.
items.flavor_text:
"No one cares about your Spider-Man obsession, Flash."
—Liz Allan
items.atomic_translated_name: 蜘蛛侠迷弟闪电·汤普森
items.atomic_translated_text:
闪现
当闪电·汤普森进场时，选择一项或都选～
•诘问不休～横置目标生物。
•英雄崇拜～重置目标生物。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 「闪电，没人在乎你有多热爱蜘蛛侠。」\n～利兹·艾伦

items.name: Annie Flash, the Veteran
items.oracle_text:
Flash
When Annie Flash enters, if you cast it, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Whenever Annie Flash becomes tapped, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
items.zhs_text: 闪现\n当探险老手电闪安妮进战场时，若它经你施放，则将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。\n每当电闪安妮成为横置时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。
items.atomic_translated_text: 闪现\n当电闪安妮进场时，若它经你施放，则将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。\n每当电闪安妮成为横置时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

items.name: Flash
items.oracle_text: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you do, sacrifice it unless you pay its mana cost reduced by {2}.
items.flavor_text: No tactic transforms a battle like a well-timed carnivore.
items.zhs_text: 你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果你如此作，则除非你支付其至多减少{2}的法术力费用，否则牺牲之。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 从扭转战局的效果看，任何战术都没有适时唤出凶猛巨兽来得有效。
items.atomic_translated_text: 你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果你如此作，则除非你支付其减少{2}的法术力费用，否则牺牲之。

items.name: Flashfreeze
items.oracle_text: Counter target red or green spell.
items.flavor_text:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master
items.zhs_text: 反击目标红色或绿色咒语。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 「你败亡之因不是由于你的无知、贫弱或傲慢，而是你的温热血液。」\n～霜风会首领亥达

items.name: Flash Flood
items.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target red permanent.
• Return target Mountain to its owner's hand.
items.flavor_text: Many people say that no power can bring the mountains low. Many people are fools.
items.atomic_translated_text: 选择一项～\n•消灭目标红色永久物。\n•将目标山脉移回其拥有者手上。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 许多人都说没有力量能夷平山脉。许多人都是傻子。

items.name: Flash Foliage
items.oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during combat after blockers are declared.
Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token that's blocking target creature attacking you.
Draw a card.
items.flavor_text:
"This undemanding vegetation takes root in a mote of dust but grows incredibly quickly."
—Simic research notes
items.zhs_text: 将一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生物放置进场，且对目标攻击你的生物进行阻挡。\n抓一张牌。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 「此类植株极富韧性，只要有颗尘埃可生根，就能快速成长。」\n～析米克研究纪录
items.atomic_translated_text: 只能于战斗中宣告阻挡者之后施放此咒语。\n派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物，且阻挡目标正向你进行攻击的生物。\n抓一张牌。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 「此类植株极富韧性，只要有颗尘埃可生根，就能快速成长。」\n～析米克研究纪录

items.name: Flash Conscription
items.oracle_text: Untap target creature and gain control of it until end of turn. That creature gains haste until end of turn. If {W} was spent to cast this spell, the creature gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage, you gain that much life" until end of turn.
items.zhs_text: 重置目标生物并获得其操控权直到回合结束。 该生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。 若你使用快速征召时支付了{W}，则该生物获得「每当此生物造成战斗伤害时，你获得等量的生命」直到回合结束。
items.atomic_translated_text: 重置目标生物并获得其操控权直到回合结束。该生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果施放此咒语时支付过{W}，则该生物获得「每当此生物造成战斗伤害时，你获得等量的生命」直到回合结束。

items.name: Flashfires
items.flavor_text: Dry grass is tinder before the spark.
items.zhs_flavor_text: 干草在火花面前即为柴火。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 干草在火花面前即为柴火。

items.name: Flash of Insight
items.oracle_text:
Look at the top X cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
Flashback—{1}{U}, Exile X blue cards from your graveyard. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost, then exile it. You can't exile Flash of Insight to pay for its own flashback cost.)
items.zhs_text: 检视你牌库顶上的X张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置于你的牌库底。\n返照～一蓝，从你的坟墓场中将X张蓝色牌移出对战。（你不能将洞察乍现本身移出对战来支付本身的返照费用）
items.atomic_translated_text: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。\n返照～{1}{U}，从你的坟墓场放逐X张蓝色牌。（你可以从你坟墓场中施放此牌，并支付其返照费用，然后将它放逐。你不能放逐洞察乍现来支付本身的返照费用。）

items.name: Flash of Defiance
items.oracle_text:
Green creatures and white creatures can't block this turn.
Flashback—{1}{R}, Pay 3 life. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
items.zhs_text: 于本回合中，牌手不能以绿色和／或白色生物进行阻挡。\n返照～一红，支付3点生命。（你可以从你的坟墓场使用此牌，并支付其返照费用。然后将它移出对战）
items.atomic_translated_text: 绿色生物和白色生物本回合不能进行阻挡。\n返照～{1}{R}，支付3点生命。（你可以从你坟墓场中施放此牌，并支付其返照费用，然后将它放逐。）

items.name: Aether Flash
items.oracle_text: Whenever a creature enters, this enchantment deals 2 damage to it.
items.flavor_text: As the foul beast appeared, arcane lightning crackled around it.
items.zhs_text: 每当任何生物进场时，乙太闪光对该生物造成2点伤害。
items.zhs_flavor_text: 当那邪兽出现时，神秘的闪光在其周围爆裂。
items.atomic_translated_text: 每当一个生物进场时，此结界对它造成2点伤害。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 当那邪兽出现时，神秘的闪光在其周围爆裂。
